messages:
Jules: FYI weekly BlueRidge health — we've got a spend spike flagged against hosted commit this morning, +320% over baseline for 03:00-04:00 UTC. Details below. @Aisha @Ravi
Aisha: thanks — do we know whether it's real traffic or a test harness?
Jules: quick look at logs, looks like a burst of bulk-embedding jobs from a single api-key (key-id: br-embed-03). ops-bot shows 18k embedding units in that hour. snippet: ```SELECT hour, sum(embedding_units) as units FROM billing_events WHERE account='blueridge' and hour >= '2026-03-18T03' GROUP BY hour; 03:00: 18000```
Tom: pinged infra to check for retries or loop. I see elevated 5xx rates at that hour (error-rate 2.8% vs baseline 0.1%). Could be client retries.
Aisha: @Tom please confirm if those 5xx correlate to the same api-key.
Tom: confirmed — majority of 5xx originate from br-embed-03's requests hitting an overloaded endpoint. Stack traces show KV cache pressure; autoscaler didn't scale due to burst policy threshold.
Jules: Action items: 1) temporary key suspend? 2) customer outreach — check if onboarding test ran; 3) apply soft rate-limit to avoid commit burn. @Ravi can you coordinate outreach?
Ravi: On it. I'll call BlueRidge PM now. Also asking for a replay of their job config. ETA 30m.
Nina: added anomaly flag in commit dashboard and annotated spike as 'embedded-batch-burst'. Also created a spend alert for 120% above rolling 7d baseline.
Aisha: If we suspend key, we should offer a safe fallback — suggest creating a sandbox key with capped qps. @Jules can you draft the message?
Jules: Draft: "Hi team — we observed a large embedding batch that exhausted your hosted commit for the hour. We've temporarily paused the key 'br-embed-03' to protect your commit. If this was intentional, reply and we'll re-enable with a capped sandbox key and guidance on batching and streaming embeddings."
Ravi: BlueRidge PM confirmed test harness kicked off overnight; they didn't expect that many vectors. They ask to re-enable with cap and want an onboarding session for batching best practices.
Aisha: great — schedule enablement. Tom — can infra add a per-key soft-QPS limiter as interim?
Tom: yes, can add soft limiter (token bucket) at 50 QPS per key for a week. Will also add metric to track rejected requests.
Jules: I'll send the message to customer + include KB links: https://redwood.ai/docs/embeddings/batching and https://redwood.ai/console/spend-anomalies. Also note renewal risk: high spend surprises like this increase churn risk — flag for CSM touchpoint next week.
Ravi: noted, putting renewal-risk tag on account and scheduling a 1:1 enablement call.
ops-bot: Incident record created: INC-2026-0318-014, linked to dashboard https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0318-014
Jules: Closing loop — monitoring for 24h, will update thread with spend reconciliation. :thumbsup:
